name: spfx-quick-view-validator
description: Real-time diagnostics for SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Adaptive Card Extension quickview.json files: duplicate element IDs, data-binding consistency and TypeScript property checks.
author: Smit P. Bhatt

commands.title: Select Quick View Files (JSON and TypeScript)

spfxQuickViewValidator.enableDuplicateId.description: Report duplicate Adaptive Card element IDs (properties named "id") in the active quickview.json.

spfxQuickViewValidator.enableDataBinding.description: Validate Adaptive Card templating expressions such as ${employeeName} against the data getter of the associated Quick View TypeScript file.

spfxQuickViewValidator.enableIdPropertyC.description: Check whether every element ID in quickview.json has a matching property declaration in the associated TypeScript file. This is a project-specific convention, not a universal Adaptive Card requirement.

enumDescriptions: Report missing element-ID properties as errors.
Report missing element-ID properties as warnings (default).
Report missing element-ID properties as informational hints.
spfxQuickViewValidator.idPropertySeverit.description: Diagnostic severity used when an element ID has no matching TypeScript property declaration.

spfxQuickViewValidator.validationDebounc.markdownDescription: Debounce, in milliseconds, before re-validating `quickview.json` while it is being edited. `0` validates synchronously on every change.

spfxQuickViewValidator.allowJsonComments.description: Allow // and /* */ comments inside quickview.json. Off by default because SharePoint requires strict JSON.

spfxQuickViewValidator.allowTrailingComm.description: Allow trailing commas inside quickview.json. Off by default because SharePoint requires strict JSON.

spfxQuickViewValidator.jsonFilePatterns.markdownDescription: File-name patterns treated as Quick View templates (matched case-insensitively against the base name, `*` as wildcard). The default covers `quickview.json`, `QuickView.json` and the standard SPFx `QuickViewTemplate.json`. Add your own file names here, e.g. `["quickview*.json", "RiseCard.json"]`.

spfxQuickViewValidator.requireManualSele.markdownDescription: When enabled, a Quick View file is only validated after you pick its JSON and TypeScript files with **SPFx Quick View Validator: Select Quick View Files (JSON and TypeScript)**. Automatic file-name matching (`jsonFilePatterns`) is then ignored, and no diagnostics appear for files you have not selected.
